content.comment_body: Hi, does anyone know how to enter and confirm a value using a mobile device? I can input the value, but there's no "enter" button—only "next." I've tried other keyboards but haven't had success. Any suggestions?
Is your phone using the Android operating system?
Yes, I'm using an Android phone.
In that case, this is a known issue. I read on the forum that using the Firefox browser might help, although I can't confirm personally since I don't have an Android device for testing.
I've tried Firefox and it worked—thanks!
Hello, you can use the checkbox option to submit your changes. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues confirming input values through the mobile on-screen keyboard while accessing the [product_name] Web Server from Android devices. The keyboard displayed a "next" button instead of a confirm option, causing confusion and workflow interruptions. Switching to the Firefox browser provided a solution, and another alternative was using a checkbox in the interface as a confirmation method.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily confirm input entries on a mobile device regardless of browser or keyboard type.
